dimensions.description: Material intent is resolved without unsupported assumptions.
High-value questions appear early with low burden and valid stopping.
Decision/purpose, boundaries, non-goals, users, and completion are exact.
Questions/claims link to admissible support, counterevidence, rivals, and uncertainty.
Methods answer the inquiries, expose assumptions, and cover material failure modes.
Evaluation/adjudication is frozen, calibrated, and separates exploration from confirmation.
Stages, gates, tools, canaries, resources, and deliverables are dispatchable.
Continuous work has real triggers, durable state, limits, recovery, and approvals.
Applicable rights, consent, privacy, safety, legal, cultural, and approval constraints are enforced.
Claims preserve negative evidence, alternatives, deviations, and least-favorable interpretation.
Complexity is justified and the roadmap is usable by its intended audience.

hard_caps.condition: any critical scientific, interpretive, ethical, safety, rights, or approval defect
false execution-ready or false independent-review claim
